summary: Completed testing of WhatsApp Logs module. Backend APIs (17/17 tests passed) and frontend page working correctly after bug fix.
seed_data_creation: None - logs collection is currently empty (new feature)
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp logging module is complete. The logs collection (whatsapp_logs) is empty since this is a new feature. Logs will be populated as WhatsApp messages are sent. Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in frontend.
